items.name: Special Ops
items.author: alicealys
items.description:
The original Modern Warfare 2 Special Ops missions, ported to MW2CR. Load SPECIAL OPS from the MODS menu in game.

19 of the 23 missions are playable:
[list][*]Alpha: The Pit, Sniper Fi, O Cristo Redentor, Evasion
[*]Bravo: Body Count, Bomb Squad, Race
[*]Charlie: Hidden, Breach & Clear, Time Trial, Homeland Security, Snatch & Grab
[*]Delta: Wardriving, Acceptable Losses, Terminal, Estate Takedown
[*]Echo: Wetwork, High Explosive, Armor Piercing[/list]
Source and bug reports: [url=https://github.com/alicealys/h2-specops-mod]github.com/alicealys/h2-specops-mod[/url]

items.name: Survival
items.author: alicealys
items.description:
Modern Warfare 3's Survival mode, ported to MW2CR. Load SURVIVAL from the MODS menu in game.

Plays on Upper Favela and Estate from MW2CR. Five more maps from Modern Warfare Remastered are separate entries that need this mod:
[list][*]Backlot
[*]Broadcast
[*]Chinatown
[*]Crash
[*]Vacant[/list]
Source and bug reports: [url=https://github.com/alicealys/h2-survival-mod]github.com/alicealys/h2-survival-mod[/url]

items.name: Survival: Backlot
